purpose: Allow two agents that already share one exact public semantic context to evolve only their session-local wire aliases when measured inclusive total-token utility improves without semantic or safety regression.
carrier_precondition: Encoding and decoding require the exact task-bound per-message fidelity input, a passing independent fidelity result, and the configured verifier digest. A bare source digest is insufficient.
negotiation: propose one exact scoped alias table
verify the frozen table artifact and exact round-trip vectors
require explicit sender and receiver acknowledgements
require receiver comprehension in the same model context

freeze one externally auditable plan artifact digest, exact message count, task set, baseline, model and tokenizer identities, positive per-call and aggregate shadow budgets, validator, accounting scope, thresholds, and verifier before execution
activate for a bounded shadow trial only; every call has a provider-enforced positive token ceiling and shadow output is never a live answer or claim artifact
measure complete inclusive total-token and safe-completion utility
keep only on strict advantage with zero semantic or safety regression and mint an exact sealed retained-surface authorization

permit live routing only through a sealed per-message route and prepared-message decision for the exact table, activation, session, model context, generation, plan, trial result, and verifier bound by that retained authorization
otherwise roll back to the exact parent or raw/JSON

alias_constraints.normalization: NFC input must already be normalized
alias_constraints.eligible_scripts: Any Unicode letter, number, or symbol scalar that passes the collision and control gates.
reject: aliases colliding with unaliased semantic tokens

optimization.proposal_score: positive frequency-weighted token savings under the worst bound tokenizer
optimization.retention_measure: strict reduction in total tokens including setup and fallback for matched safely completed tasks
trial_evidence_binding: frozen external plan-artifact sha256 and exact planned message count
exact session id, model-context id, table generation, and evolving-surface Capsule sha256
hard_gates: all bounded-trial messages preserve tested semantics
negation, null, failure, and refusal are preserved

fallback.without_retained_surface_authorization: shadow only; never deliver as a live answer
fallback.on_unknown_or_stale_alias: reject and use the exact parent, raw concise text, or canonical JSON

trust_boundary: The host envelope supplies integrity and identity binding only. Authenticated transport, anti-replay state, sandbox enforcement, and trustworthy provider receipts are external requirements.
